improved_curse_of_agony.name: Improved Curse of Agony
improved_curse_of_agony.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Curse of Agony by [V1]%.

suppression.name: Suppression
suppression.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to hit with spells by [V1]%, and reduces the mana cost of your Affliction spells by [V2]%.

improved_corruption.name: Improved Corruption
improved_corruption.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Corruption by [V1]%, and increases the critical strike chance of your Seed of Corruption by [V2]%.

improved_curse_of_weakness.name: Improved Curse of Weakness
improved_curse_of_weakness.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of attack power reduced by your Curse of Weakness by [V1]%.

improved_drain_soul.name: Improved Drain Soul
improved_drain_soul.tooltipTemplate: Returns [V1]% of your maximum mana if the target is killed by you while you drain its soul.  In addition, your Affliction spells generate [V2]% less threat.

improved_life_tap.name: Improved Life Tap
improved_life_tap.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by [V1]%.

soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
soul_siphon.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells by an additional [V1]% for each of your Affliction effects on the target, up to a maximum of [V2]% additional effect.

improved_fear.name: Improved Fear
improved_fear.tooltipTemplate: Causes your Fear spell to inflict a Nightmare on the target when the fear effect ends. The Nightmare effect reduces the target's movement speed by [V1]% for 5 sec.

fel_concentration.name: Fel Concentration
fel_concentration.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks  while casting Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul,  Unstable Affliction, and Haunt spells by 70%.

amplify_curse.name: Amplify Curse
amplify_curse.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the global cooldown of your Curses by -0.5 sec.

grim_reach.name: Grim Reach
grim_reach.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by [V1]%.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.tooltipTemplate:
Gives your Corruption and Drain Life spells a [V1]% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance state after damaging the opponent.  The Shadow Trance state reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

This chance increases by an additional [V2]% every time Shadow Trance does not trigger.

empowered_corruption.name: Empowered Corruption
empowered_corruption.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Corruption spell by an amount equal to [V1]% of your spell power.

shadow_embrace.name: Shadow Embrace
shadow_embrace.tooltipTemplate: Your Shadow Bolt and Haunt spells apply the Shadow Embrace effect, increasing all shadow periodic damage dealt to the target by you by [V1]%, and reduces all periodic healing done to the target by [V2]%. Lasts for 12 sec. Stacks up to 3 times.

siphon_life.name: Siphon Life
siphon_life.tooltipTemplate: When you deal damage with your Corruption spell, you are instantly healed for 40% of the damage done. In addition, the damage done by your Corruption, Seed of Corruption and Unstable Affliction damage over time effects is increased by 5%.

curse_of_exhaustion.name: Curse of Exhaustion
curse_of_exhaustion.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

improved_felhunter.name: Improved Felhunter
improved_felhunter.tooltipTemplate: Your Felhunter regains [V1]% of its maximum mana each time it hits with its Shadow Bite ability and the cooldown on that ability is reduced by [V2] sec.  In addition, increases the effect of your Felhunter's Fel Intelligence by [V3]%.

shadow_mastery.name: Shadow Mastery
shadow_mastery.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells and your Felhunter's Shadow Bite ability by [V1]%.

eradication.name: Eradication
eradication.tooltipTemplate: When you deal damage with Corruption, you have 6% chance to increase your spell casting speed by [V1]% for 10 sec.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of Curse of Agony, Corruption and Seed of Corruption by 6% and reduces the chance your helpful Affliction spells and damage over time effects  will be dispelled by an additional 30%.

dark_pact.name: Dark Pact
dark_pact.tooltipTemplate: Drains 305 of your summoned demon's Mana, returning 100% to you.

improved_howl_of_terror.name: Improved Howl of Terror
improved_howl_of_terror.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Howl of Terror spell by [V1] sec.

malediction.name: Malediction
malediction.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell damage by [V1]%, increases the periodic critical strike chance of your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells by [V2]%, and makes your Curse of the Elements increase magic damage taken by an additional [V3]%.

deaths_embrace.name: Death's Embrace
deaths_embrace.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life by [V1]% while your health is at or below 20% health, and increases the damage done by your Shadow spells by [V2]% when your target is at or below 35% health.

unstable_affliction.name: Unstable Affliction
unstable_affliction.tooltipTemplate: Shadow energy slowly destroys the target, causing 640 damage over 15 sec.  In addition, if the Unstable Affliction is dispelled it will cause 1440 damage to the dispeller and silence them for 5 sec. Only one Unstable Affliction or Immolate per Warlock can be active on any one target.

pandemic.name: Pandemic
pandemic.tooltipTemplate: Grants the periodic damage from your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells the ability to critically hit for 100% increased damage, and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Haunt spell by 100%.

everlasting_affliction.name: Everlasting Affliction
everlasting_affliction.tooltipTemplate: Your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells gain an additional [V1]% of your bonus spell damage, and your Drain Life, Drain Soul, Shadow Bolt, and Haunt spells have a [V2]% chance to reset the duration of your Corruption spell on the target.

haunt.name: Haunt
haunt.tooltipTemplate: You send a ghostly soul into the target, dealing 405 to 473 Shadow damage and increasing all damage done by your Shadow damage-over-time effects on the target by 20% for 12 sec. When the Haunt spell ends or is dispelled, the soul returns to you, healing you for 100% of the damage it did to the target.

improved_healthstone.name: Improved Healthstone
improved_healthstone.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of Health restored by your Healthstone by [V1]%.

improved_imp.name: Improved Imp
improved_imp.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of your Imp's Firebolt, Fire Shield, and Blood Pact spells by [V1]%.

fel_synergy.name: Fel Synergy
fel_synergy.tooltipTemplate: You have a [V1]% chance to heal your pet for 15% of the amount of spell damage done by you.

improved_health_funnel.name: Improved Health Funnel
improved_health_funnel.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of Health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by [V1]% and reduces the health cost by [V2]%. In addition, your summoned Demon takes [V3]% less damage while under the effect of your Health Funnel.

demonic_brutality.name: Demonic Brutality
demonic_brutality.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice and Suffering spells by [V1]%, and increases the attack power bonus on your Felguard's Demonic Frenzy effect by [V2]%.

fel_vitality.name: Fel Vitality
fel_vitality.tooltipTemplate: Increases the Stamina and Intellect of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard by [V1]% and increases your maximum health and mana by [V2]%.

dark_fixation.name: Dark Fixation
dark_fixation.tooltipTemplate: Increases your armor by [V1]% of your spell power. Damage dealt to yourself with Life Tap is converted into an absorb shield equal to the self-inflicted damage.

improved_succubus.name: Improved Succubus
improved_succubus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Succubus' Seduction by [V1]%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by [V2]%.

soul_link.name: Soul Link
soul_link.tooltipTemplate: When active, 20% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter, Felguard, or enslaved demon instead.  That damage cannot be prevented. Lasts as long as the demon is active and controlled.

fel_domination.name: Fel Domination
fel_domination.tooltipTemplate: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter or Felguard Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

demonic_aegis.name: Demonic Aegis
demonic_aegis.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Armor, Summoner's Armor and Fel Armor spells by [V1]%.

unholy_power.name: Unholy Power
unholy_power.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard's melee attacks and your Imp's Firebolt by [V1]%.

master_summoner.name: Master Summoner
master_summoner.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Fel Guard Summoning spells by [V1] sec and the Mana cost by [V2]%.

mana_feed.name: Mana Feed
mana_feed.tooltipTemplate: When you gain mana from Drain Mana or Life Tap spells, your summoned demon gains 100% of the mana you gain.

master_conjuror.name: Master Conjuror
master_conjuror.tooltipTemplate: Increases the combat ratings gained from your conjured Firestone and Spellstone by [V1]%.

taste_for_torment.name: Taste for Torment
taste_for_torment.tooltipTemplate: Soul Gorge’s healing is increased by up to [V1]% of damage taken in the last 5 seconds. Searing Pain has a [V2]% chance to reset the cooldown of Soul Gorge.

master_demonologist.name: Master Demonologist
master_demonologist.tooltipTemplate:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases your Fire damage by [V1]%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Fire spells by [V2]%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by [V3]%.

Succubus - Increases your Shadow damage by [V4]%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by [V5]%.

Felhunter - Reduces all spell damage taken by [V6]%.

Felguard - Increases all damage done by [V7]%, and reduces all damage taken by [V8]%.

Enslaved Demons - Increases all damage done by [V9]%, and reduces all damage taken by [V10]%.

molten_core.name: Molten Core
molten_core.tooltipTemplate:
Increases the duration of your Immolate by [V1] sec, and you have a [V2]% chance to gain the Molten Core effect when your Corruption deals damage. The Molten Core effect empowers your next 3 Incinerate or Soul Fire spells cast within 15 sec.

Incinerate - Increases damage done by [V3]% and reduces cast time by [V4]%.

Soul Fire - Increases damage done by [V5]% and increases critical strike chance by [V6]%.

demonic_resilience.name: Demonic Resilience
demonic_resilience.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee and spells by [V1]% and reduces all damage your summoned demon takes by [V2]%.

demonic_empowerment.name: Demonic Empowerment
demonic_empowerment.tooltipTemplate:
Grants the Warlock's summoned demon Empowerment.

Imp - Increases the Imp's spell critical strike chance by 20% for 30 sec.

Voidwalker - Increases the Voidwalker's health by 20%, and its threat generated from spells and attacks by 20% for 20 sec.

Succubus - Instantly vanishes, causing the Succubus to go into an improved Invisibility state. The vanish effect removes all stuns, snares and movement impairing effects from the Succubus.

Felhunter - Dispels all magical effects from the Felhunter.

Felguard - Increases the Felguard's attack speed by 20% and breaks all stun, snare and movement impairing effects and makes your Felguard immune to them for 15 sec.

demonic_knowledge.name: Demonic Knowledge
demonic_knowledge.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell damage by an amount equal to [V1]% of the total of your active demon's Stamina plus Intellect.

demonic_tactics.name: Demonic Tactics
demonic_tactics.tooltipTemplate: Increases melee and spell critical strike chance for you and your summoned demon by [V1]%.

decimation.name: Decimation
decimation.tooltipTemplate: When you Shadow Bolt, Incinerate or Soul Fire a target that is at or below 35% health, the cast time of your Soul Fire spell is reduced by 40% for 10 sec. Soul Fires cast under the effect of Decimation cost no shard.

improved_demonic_tactics.name: Improved Demonic Tactics
improved_demonic_tactics.tooltipTemplate:
Increases the critical strike chance of your summoned demon by an amount equal to [V1]% of your spell critical strike chance. 

Additionally, when your pet is below 20% health, the damage it takes from your Soul Link is reduced by [V2]%.

summon_felguard.name: Summon Felguard
summon_felguard.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Felguard under the command of the Warlock.

nemesis.name: Nemesis
nemesis.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Demonic Empowerment, Metamorphosis, Fel Domination and Reign of Dread spells by [V1]%.

demonic_pact.name: Demonic Pact
demonic_pact.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell damage by [V1]%, and your pet's criticals apply the Demonic Pact effect to yourself, party and raid members. Demonic Pact increases spell power by [V2]% of your Spell Damage for 45 sec. This effect has a 20 sec cooldown. Does not work on Enslaved demons.

metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
metamorphosis.tooltipTemplate: You transform into a Demon for 30 sec.  This form increases your armor by 600%, damage by 20%, reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6% and reduces the duration of stun and snare effects by 50%.  You gain some unique demon abilities in addition to your normal abilities. 3 minute cooldown.

reign_of_dread.name: Reign of Dread
reign_of_dread.tooltipTemplate: Surge into the air and scorch all enemies below with 1590 Shadowflame damage over 2.5 seconds. While airborne melee attacks against you have 60% increased chance to miss.

improved_shadow_bolt.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
improved_shadow_bolt.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Shadow Bolt spell by [V1]%, and your Shadow Bolt has a [V2]% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to spell damage, increasing spell critical strike chance against that target by 5%. Effect lasts 30 sec.

bane.name: Bane
bane.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt. Chaos Bolt and Immolate spells by [V1] sec and your Soul Fire spell by [V2] sec.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.tooltipTemplate: Increases the periodic damage done by your Immolate by [V1]%, and your Conflagrate has a [V2]% chance to daze the target for 5 sec.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by [V1]%.

demonic_power.name: Demonic Power
demonic_power.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' Lash of Pain spell by [V1] sec. and reduces the casting time of your Imp's Firebolt spell by [V2] sec.

shadowburn.name: Shadowburn
shadowburn.tooltipTemplate: Instantly blasts the target for 118 to 130 Shadowflame damage.  If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

ruin.name: Ruin
ruin.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells and your Imp's Firebolt spell by [V1]%.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks  while casting or channeling any Destruction spell by 70%.

destructive_reach.name: Destructive Reach
destructive_reach.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by [V1]% and reduces threat caused by Destruction spells by [V2]%.

improved_searing_pain.name: Improved Searing Pain
improved_searing_pain.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by [V1]%.

backlash.name: Backlash
backlash.tooltipTemplate: Increases your critical strike chance with spells by an additional [V1]% and gives you a [V2]% chance when hit by a physical attack to reduce the cast time of your next Shadow Bolt or Incinerate spell by 100%.  This effect lasts 8 sec and will not occur more than once every 8 seconds.

improved_immolate.name: Improved Immolate
improved_immolate.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Immolate spell by [V1]%.

devastation.name: Devastation
devastation.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 5%.

nether_protection.name: Nether Protection
nether_protection.tooltipTemplate: After being hit with a spell, you have a [V1]% chance to gain Nether Protection, reducing all damage by that spell school by 30% for 8 sec.

emberstorm.name: Emberstorm
emberstorm.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Fire and Shadow spells by [V1]% and reduces the cast time of your Incinerate spell by [V2] sec.

conflagrate.name: Conflagrate
conflagrate.tooltipTemplate: Consumes an Immolate or Shadowflame effect on the enemy target to instantly deal damage equal to 60% of your Immolate or Shadowflame, and causes an additional 40% damage over 0 sec.

soul_leech.name: Soul Leech
soul_leech.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Shadow Bolt, Shadowburn, Chaos Bolt, Soul Fire, Incinerate, Searing Pain and Conflagrate spells a [V1]% chance to return health equal to 20% of the damage caused.

pyroclasm.name: Pyroclasm
pyroclasm.tooltipTemplate: When you critically strike with Searing Pain or Conflagrate, your Fire and Shadow spell damage is increased by [V1]% for 10 sec.

shadow_and_flame.name: Shadow and Flame
shadow_and_flame.tooltipTemplate: Your Shadow Bolt, Shadowburn, Chaos Bolt and Incinerate spells gain an additional [V1]% of your bonus spell damage effects.

improved_soul_leech.name: Improved Soul Leech
improved_soul_leech.tooltipTemplate: Your Soul Leech effect also restores mana to you and your summoned demon equal to [V1]% of maximum mana, and has a [V2]% chance to grant up to 10 party or raid members mana regeneration equal to 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

backdraft.name: Backdraft
backdraft.tooltipTemplate: When you cast Conflagrate, the cast time and global cooldown of your next three Destruction spells is reduced by [V1]%. Lasts 15 sec.

shadowfury.name: Shadowfury
shadowfury.tooltipTemplate: Shadowfury is unleashed, causing 357 to 421 Shadow damage and stunning all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.

empowered_imp.name: Empowered Imp
empowered_imp.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Imp's Firebolt by [V1]%, and all critical hits done by your Imp have a [V2]% chance to increase your spell critical hit chance for your next spell by 100%. This effect lasts 8 sec.

fire_and_brimstone.name: Fire and Brimstone
fire_and_brimstone.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Incinerate and Chaos Bolt spells to targets afflicted by your Immolate by [V1]%, and the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell is increased by [V2]%.

chaos_bolt.name: Chaos Bolt
chaos_bolt.tooltipTemplate: Sends a bolt of chaotic fire at the enemy, dealing 870 to 1049 Shadowflame damage. Chaos Bolt cannot be resisted, and pierces through all absorption effects.

enchants.name: Blood Horror
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Blood Horror. 
Blood Horror: While channeling, encases yourself in a barrier of blood, making you immune to silence, stun and interrupt effects. Any time an enemy within 25 yards deals non-periodic damage to you, you drain their health and cause them to run in horror for 4 sec.

enchants.name: Burning Rush
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Burning Rush. 
Burning Rush: Drains 3% of your maximum health per second to increase your movement speed by 50%. Movement-impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until cancelled.

enchants.name: Demonic Leap
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Demonic Leap. 
Demonic Leap: Leap into the air upon demonic wings, moving a short distance. If you reactivate it within 1 sec you will leap again.

enchants.name: Soul Swap
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Soul Swap. 
Soul Swap: You copy your Corruption, Curse of Agony and Unstable Affliction effects from the target.

For 5 sec afterwards, the next target you cast Soul Swap: Exhale on will be afflicted by the copied damage-over-time effects.

You cannot Soul Swap to the same target.

enchants.name: Unending Resolve
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Unending Resolve. 
Unending Resolve: Hardens your skin, reducing all damage taken by 30% and granting immunity to interrupt, silence, and pushback effects for 8 sec.

(60% while in Dark Apotheosis)

enchants.name: Agent of Chaos
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Chaos Bolt
Immolate deals half as much direct damage but lasts for 3 seconds longer.

Periodic damage from Immolate benefits from spell haste and reduces the cooldown of Chaos Bolt by 0.5 sec.

enchants.name: Agonizing Coil
enchants.tooltip:
Using Death Coil applies Curse of Agony on the target and harvests their essence, granting you 10% increased chance to critically strike with spells for 15 sec.

The cooldown of Death Coil is reduced by 90 sec, however it no longer causes the target to run in horror.

enchants.name: Chaos Manifesting
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Chaos Bolt
After casting Chaos Bolt, you receive a Fire or Shadow Empowerment, increasing your damage dealt with that school by 10% for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Cursed Shadows
enchants.tooltip: Dealing damage with Curse of Agony has a 30% chance to increase the damage of your next Shadow Bolt by 20% and to reduce its mana cost by 20%. Lasts for 12 sec.

enchants.name: Curseweaver
enchants.tooltip:
Your Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom no longer occupy a Curse slot, meaning they can be applied alongside any other curse.

Corruption deals 4% more damage per Curse that you have applied on the target.

enchants.name: Dark Harvest
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing periodic damage with Corruption, Curse of Agony, Seed of Corruption or Unstable Affliction increases the damage of your next Drain Life by 5%, stacking up to 10 times.

Killing an opponent that yields experience or honor grants 3 stacks.

enchants.name: Decisive Decimation
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Conflagrate
Casting Conflagrate reduces the cast time of your next Soul Fire by 30% and removes the Soul Shard cost.

enchants.name: Demonic Influence
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Metamorphosis
While in Metamorphosis your Demon and Wild Imps deal 20% increased damage.

enchants.name: Demonic Persistence
enchants.tooltip: Casting Hand of Gul'dan increases the damage of your summoned demon and Wild Imps by 5%, stacking up to 3 times. Lasts 35 seconds.

enchants.name: Demonic Siphon
enchants.tooltip: When your Drain Life deals damage it also heals your summoned demon for 2% of its health and increases its damage by 3%, stacking up to 5 times. Lasts for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Demonic Whirl
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Summon Felguard
Dealing damage with Shadow Bolt or Incinerate causes your Felguard to cast a Whirlwind, dealing damage to enemies within 8 yards.

This can only occur once every 3 sec.

enchants.name: Doomcaller's Wrath
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Eradication
Using Curse of Doom grants you Eradication.

Duration of Eradication is increased by 5 seconds.

Increases the damage of Curse of Doom by 30%.

enchants.name: Dread Communion
enchants.tooltip: Your demon is healed for 25% of the healing you receive. Casting Demonic Empowerment triples the effect of your Master Demonologist talent for 10 seconds.

enchants.name: Dusk Till Dawn
enchants.tooltip:
Casting Shadow Bolt, Incinerate, Soul Fire, Searing Pain or Chaos Bolt grants you Dusk Till Dawn.
Dusk Till Dawn: Increases the damage of your next Shadowburn by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.

When used with at least 3 stacks, Shadowburn hits 2 additional targets, applies Corruption to the targets and doesn't cost a Soul Shard.

enchants.name: Endless Flames
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Pyroclasm and Shadowflame by 6 seconds. Additionally, Shadowflame deals 15% increased damage.

enchants.name: Eternal Torment
enchants.tooltip:
Your Haunt increases the damage of your Shadow damage-over-time effects by an additional 7%. 

Your Soul Swap: Exhale can now be cast to apply your DoTs on two targets.

enchants.name: Fel Damnation
enchants.tooltip: After using Fel Domination your next Hand of Gul'dan summons double the amount of Wild Imps. Casting Hand of Gul'dan reduces the cooldown of Fel Domination by 15 seconds.

enchants.name: Fire Attunement
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Molten Core
Dealing damage with Immolate grants you Fire Attunement.
Fire Attunement: Increases the chance to trigger your next Molten Core talent by 1%. Stacks up to 15 and lasts 15 sec.

enchants.name: Fire Storm
Gul'dan's Chosen
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Chaos Bolt
Casting Chaos Bolt causes your Destruction spells to not consume Backdraft for 4 sec.

enchants.name: Heating Up!
enchants.tooltip: Your Conflagrate has 15% increased critical chance and increases your Fire damage dealt to the target by 2%, stacking up to 5 times.

enchants.name: Heretic of Gul'dan
enchants.tooltip: Your Incinerate, Soul Fire and Shadow Bolt reduce the cooldown of Hand of Gul'dan by 0 sec.

enchants.name: Inferno
enchants.tooltip: Enemies hit by your Hellfire have a 20% chance to trigger an additional Hellfire explosion, dealing 50% of the original damage.

enchants.name: Inner Flame
enchants.tooltip: Dealing direct damage with Fire or Shadow spells has a 12% chance to cause your next direct damage Fire spell to be a guaranteed critical strike.

enchants.name: Pendulum
enchants.tooltip: Receive 3% spell haste while above 50% mana and 3% spell critical strike chance while below 50% mana.

enchants.name: Pure Shadow
enchants.tooltip: Casting offensive Shadow spells increases the damage of Shadow Bolt by 1%, Shadow Crash by 5% and Shadowfury by 10%. Lasts for 15 sec and stacks up to 6 times.

enchants.name: Pyroclasmic Shadows
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Pyroclasm
Your Pyroclasm also increases the critical strike chance of your Shadow Bolt by 20%.

enchants.name: Searing Brand
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Dark Apotheosis
Your Searing Pain reduces the targets attack power by 151. This does not stack with other similar effects. 

Branding a target deals additional high-threat Fire damage, this can only occur once every 15 seconds per target.

enchants.name: Searing Flames
enchants.tooltip:
The periodic effect of Immolate now deals damage to all enemies within 8 yards of the target, but can only be active on one target at a time.

Each time Immolate deals periodic damage, your Imp's Firebolt critical strike chance increases by 3%, consumed when it critically hits.

enchants.name: Shadow Funnel
enchants.tooltip: While channeling Health Funnel on your Voidwalker, its auto-attacks trigger a Void Nova, dealing Shadow damage to enemies within 5 yards. In addition, your Health Funnel does not cause any threat.

enchants.name: Shadow Siphon
enchants.tooltip: Your Shadowburn deals 25% more damage to targets below 35% health and restores 10% health when you gain a Soul Shard from Shadowburn.

enchants.name: Soul Link
Sudden Aftermath
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Aftermath
Casting Immolate on a monster which is not in combat triggers Aftermath, slowing it by 70% for 5 sec. In addition, your Aftermath increases the damage of your Immolate by 10%.

enchants.name: Twilight Reaper
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Nightfall
The Shadow Trance effect from Nightfall also reduces the mana cost of your Shadow Bolt by 100%.

Shadow Trance also makes the Shadow Bolt heal you for 50% of the damage dealt.

After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor you trigger Shadow Trance.

enchants.name: Unstable Void
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Backdraft
Requires Backlash
Your Shadowfury and Shadow Crash trigger your Backdraft talent. If these deal damage to a monster Backlash talent also triggers.
Backdraft: Cast time and global cooldown of your next three Destruction spell reduced by 30%.

enchants.name: Wanding
enchants.tooltip: Wand attacks grant you stacks that increase the cast speed of your next spell by 5%, stacks up to 5 times and lasts 6 sec.

enchants.name: Wild Felfire
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Chaos Bolt
Dealing damage with Chaos Bolt calls down a fiery rain, dealing 82.94 Fire damage to nearby enemies every second for 4 sec.

enchants.name: Affliction Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your spell haste by 4% and the damage of your Corruption by 6%.

enchants.name: Bane of Havoc
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Bane of Havoc. 

Bane of Havoc: Curses the ground with a demonic bane, causing your Shadow Bolt, Incinerate, Soul Fire and Chaos Bolt spells to also strike targets marked with the bane for 50% of the damage dealt and have 15% increased critical strike chance. Lasts 15 sec.

enchants.name: Cataclysmic Burst
enchants.tooltip: Dealing damage with Incinerate extends the duration of your Immolate by 2 seconds and increases the periodic damage of Immolate by 10%, stacking up to 4 times. This effect is consumed when casting Conflagrate.

enchants.name: Crazy Cultist
enchants.tooltip: Your damaging Warlock spell casts have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Warlock spell for free.

enchants.name: Demonic Reoccurence
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Metamorphosis
Reduces the cooldown of Metamorphosis by 75 sec, but reduces the bonus armor granted by 50% and you no longer benefit from the reduced chance to be crit or reduced duration of stuns and snares.

enchants.name: Demonology Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage done by your summoned demon by 10% and its attack speed by 10%.

enchants.name: Destruction Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your Fire and Shadow damage done by 4% and the damage of your Immolate by an additional 5%.

enchants.name: Endless Agony
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Curse of Agony applies Endless Agony.

Dealing damage with Drain Life reduces the active duration and cooldown of your Curse of Doom by 3 sec.

After a target of your Curse of Agony dies, any stacks of Endless Agony will be spread to nearby enemies within 10 yards.
Endless Agony: Increases your damage dealt to the target with Curse of Agony by 4% and Curse of Doom by 7%. Stacks up to 20 times and lasts for 12 sec.

enchants.name: Enslave Demon
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you how to permanently Enslave Demons. 
Enslave Demon: Begins enslaving a demon to be your companion. 

Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the demon for 20 sec. 

If you lose the demon's attention for any reason, the enslaving process will fail. Each type of demon has unique abilities that you will be able to make use of.

enchants.name: Feeding the Abyss
enchants.tooltip:
Your ability to Dodge is replaced with a dark hunger. You have a chance to fully absorb incoming physical damage, storing it for later use. After 10 seconds the stored damage is fed to the abyss, causing your next Life Tap to deal damage to nearby enemies, healing you and your pet based on the damage dealt.

@ext:The chance for the absorb to trigger is equal to 10% plus your spell critical strike chance.:ext@

enchants.name: Hand of Gul'dan
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Hand of Gul'dan. 
Hand of Gul'dan: Calls down a demonic meteor dealing 295.24 Shadowflame damage to enemies within 5 yards and summons 4 Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target for 12 sec.

enchants.name: Nether Portal
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Nether Portal.
 
Nether Portal: Tear open a portal to the Twisting Nether for 30 sec. Casting Shadow Bolt, Soul Fire or Incinerate summons a demon to fight for you. During Decimation your Soul Fire summons an additional demon.

enchants.name: Shadow Crash
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Shadow Crash. 
Shadow Crash: Hurl a bolt of slow-moving Shadow energy at the destination, dealing Shadow damage to enemies within 8 yards, pulling them towards the center of the explosion and slowing them by 70% for 3 sec.

enchants.name: Soul Erosion
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Unstable Affliction and Curse of Agony has a 8% chance to increase the damage of your next Drain Soul by 300% (500% if the target is below 25% health). Drain Soul cast this way only lasts for 6 sec but is impervious to spell pushback.

In addition, using Drain Soul the duration of your Haunt, Unstable Affliction, and Shadow Embrace is not reduced on the target.

enchants.name: Soul Harvest
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Soul Harvest. 
Soul Harvest: Increases your magic damage and your pets' damage by 15%. Lasts 6 sec, increased by 3 sec for each target afflicted by your Corruption, Curse of Agony and Immolate up to a maximum of 24 sec.

Does not stack with other similar effects.

enchants.name: Aftermath
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the periodic damage done by your Immolate by 6%, and your Conflagrate has a 100% chance to daze the target for 5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Aftermath Talent.

enchants.name: Amplify Curse
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the global cooldown of your Curses by -0.5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Amplify Curse Talent.

enchants.name: Bane
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt. Chaos Bolt and Immolate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Bane Talent.

enchants.name: Cataclysm
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Cataclysm Talent.

enchants.name: Dark Power Well
enchants.tooltip: Casting damaging Shadow spells has a 15% chance to make your next non-Shadow spell have no cost.

enchants.name: Demonic Aegis
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Armor, Summoner's Armor and Fel Armor spells by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Demonic Aegis Talent.

enchants.name: Demonic Brutality
Demonic Embrace
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your total Stamina by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Demonic Embrace Talent.

enchants.name: Demonic Power
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' Lash of Pain spell by 6 sec. and reduces the casting time of your Imp's Firebolt spell by -0.50 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Demonic Power Talent.

enchants.name: Destructive Reach
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the range of your Destruction spells by 20% and reduces threat caused by Destruction spells by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Destructive Reach Talent.

enchants.name: Empowered Corruption
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage of your Corruption spell by an amount equal to 36% of your spell power.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Empowered Corruption Talent.

enchants.name: Fel Concentration
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks  while casting Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul,  Unstable Affliction, and Haunt spells by 70%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Fel Concentration Talent.

enchants.name: Fel Domination
Fel Synergy
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
You have a 100% chance to heal your pet for 15% of the amount of spell damage done by you.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Fel Synergy Talent.

enchants.name: Fel Vitality
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the Stamina and Intellect of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard by 15% and increases your maximum health and mana by 3%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Fel Vitality Talent.

enchants.name: Glyph of Chaos Bolt
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown on Chaos Bolt by -2 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Conflagrate
enchants.tooltip: Your Conflagrate spell no longer consumes your Immolate or Shadowflame spell from the target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Corruption
enchants.tooltip: Your Corruption spell has a 5% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance state after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance state reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Curse of Agony
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of your Curse of Agony by 4 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Death Coil
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of your Death Coil by 0.5 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Demonic Circle
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown on Demonic Circle by -4 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Fear
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage your Fear target can take before the Fear effect is removed by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Felguard
enchants.tooltip: Increases the Felguard's total attack power by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Felhunter
enchants.tooltip: When your Felhunter uses Devour Magic, you will also be healed for that amount.

enchants.name: Glyph of Haunt
enchants.tooltip: The bonus damage granted by your Haunt spell is increased by an additional 3%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Health Funnel
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while channeling your Health Funnel spell by 100%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Healthstone
enchants.tooltip: You receive 30% more healing from using a healthstone.

enchants.name: Glyph of Howl of Terror
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown on your Howl of Terror spell by -8 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Immolate
enchants.tooltip: Increases the periodic damage of your Immolate by 10%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Imp
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage done by your Imp's Firebolt spell by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Incinerate
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage done by Incinerate by 5%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Life Tap
enchants.tooltip: When you use Life Tap or Dark Pact, you gain 20% of your Spirit as spell power for 40 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Metamorphosis
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of your Metamorphosis by 6 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Quick Decay
enchants.tooltip: Your haste now reduces the time between periodic damage ticks of your Corruption spell.

enchants.name: Glyph of Searing Pain
enchants.tooltip: Increases the critical strike bonus of your Searing Pain by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Shadow Bolt
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cast time of your Shadow Bolt by 6%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Shadowburn
enchants.tooltip: Increases the critical strike chance and damage of Shadowburn by 20% when the target is below 35% health.

enchants.name: Glyph of Shadowflame
enchants.tooltip: Your Shadowflame also applies a 70% movement speed slow on its victims.

enchants.name: Glyph of Siphon Life
enchants.tooltip: Increases the healing you receive from your Siphon Life talent by 25%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Soul Link
enchants.tooltip: Increases the percentage of damage shared via your Soul Link by an additional 5%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Soulstone
enchants.tooltip: Increases the amount of health you gain from resurrecting via a Soulstone by 300%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Succubus
enchants.tooltip: Your Succubus's Seduction ability also removes all damage over time effects from the target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Unstable Affliction
enchants.tooltip: Decreases the casting time of your Unstable Affliction by -0.2 sec and your Unstable Affliction lasts for 3 additional seconds.

enchants.name: Glyph of Voidwalker
enchants.tooltip: Increases your Voidwalker's total Stamina by 20%.

enchants.name: Grim Reach
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the range of your Affliction spells by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Grim Reach Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Corruption
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage done by your Corruption by 10%, and increases the critical strike chance of your Seed of Corruption by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Corruption Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Curse of Agony
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage done by your Curse of Agony by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Curse of Agony Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Curse of Weakness
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the amount of attack power reduced by your Curse of Weakness by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Curse of Weakness Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Drain Soul
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Returns 15% of your maximum mana if the target is killed by you while you drain its soul.  In addition, your Affliction spells generate 20% less threat.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Drain Soul Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Fear
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Causes your Fear spell to inflict a Nightmare on the target when the fear effect ends. The Nightmare effect reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Fear Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Health Funnel
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the amount of Health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 20% and reduces the health cost by 20%. In addition, your summoned Demon takes 30% less damage while under the effect of your Health Funnel.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Health Funnel Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Healthstone
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the amount of Health restored by your Healthstone by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Healthstone Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Imp
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the effect of your Imp's Firebolt, Fire Shield, and Blood Pact spells by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Imp Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Life Tap
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Life Tap Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Searing Pain
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Searing Pain Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage done by your Shadow Bolt spell by 10%, and your Shadow Bolt has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to spell damage, increasing spell critical strike chance against that target by 5%. Effect lasts 30 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Shadow Bolt Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Succubus
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cast time of your Succubus' Seduction by 66%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Succubus Talent.

enchants.name: Intensity
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks  while casting or channeling any Destruction spell by 70%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Intensity Talent.

enchants.name: Master Summoner
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Fel Guard Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Master Summoner Talent.

enchants.name: Molten Skin
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces all damage taken by 6%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Molten Skin Talent.

enchants.name: Nightfall
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives your Corruption and Drain Life spells a 2% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance state after damaging the opponent.  The Shadow Trance state reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

This chance increases by an additional 2% every time Shadow Trance does not trigger.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Nightfall Talent.

enchants.name: Ruin
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells and your Imp's Firebolt spell by 100%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Ruin Talent.

enchants.name: Shadowburn
Soul Siphon
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells by an additional 6% for each of your Affliction effects on the target, up to a maximum of 18% additional effect.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Soul Siphon Talent.

enchants.name: Suppression
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your chance to hit with spells by 3%, and reduces the mana cost of your Affliction spells by 6%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Suppression Talent.

enchants.name: Unholy Power
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage done by your Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard's melee attacks and your Imp's Firebolt by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Unholy Power Talent.

abilities.name: Corruption
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Corrupts the target, causing 822 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Agony
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Curses the target with agony, causing 1176 Shadow damage over 24 sec.  This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Curse reaches its full duration.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Curse of Doom
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Curses the target with impending doom, causing 2765 Shadow damage after 1 min.  If the target yields experience or honor when it dies from this damage, a Doomguard will be summoned.  Cannot be cast on players.

abilities.name: Curse of the Elements
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Arcane, Fire, Frost, Nature and Shadow resistances by 75 and increasing magic damage taken by 13%.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Curse of Tongues
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30%.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.  Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Weakness
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Target's melee attack power is reduced by 163 and armor is reduced by 5% for 2 min.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Dark Pact
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Drains 305 of your summoned demon's Mana, returning 100% to you.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 406 Shadow damage.  The caster gains 300% of the damage caused in health.

abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Transfers 71 health every 1 sec from the target to the caster.  Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Drain Mana
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Transfers 3% of target's maximum mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster (up to a maximum of 6% of the caster's maximum mana every 1 sec).  Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Drain Soul
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Drains the soul of the target, causing 455 Shadow damage over 15 sec.  If the target is at or below 25% health, Drain Soul causes four times the normal damage. If the target dies while being drained, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.  Each time the Drain Soul damages the target, it also has a chance to generate a Soul Shard.  Soul Shards are required for other spells.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You send a ghostly soul into the target, dealing 405 to 473 Shadow damage and increasing all damage done by your Shadow damage-over-time effects on the target by 20% for 12 sec. When the Haunt spell ends or is dispelled, the soul returns to you, healing you for 100% of the damage it did to the target.

abilities.name: Howl of Terror
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 8 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Life Tap
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Converts 851 health into 851 mana.  Spell power increases the amount of mana returned.

abilities.name: Seed of Corruption
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Imbeds a demon seed in the enemy target, causing 504 Shadow damage over 18 sec.  When the target takes 515 total damage or dies, the seed will inflict 555 to 653 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards of the target.  Only one Corruption spell per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Unstable Affliction
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Shadow energy slowly destroys the target, causing 640 damage over 15 sec.  In addition, if the Unstable Affliction is dispelled it will cause 1440 damage to the dispeller and silence them for 5 sec. Only one Unstable Affliction or Immolate per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Banish
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec.  Only one target can be banished at a time.  Casting Banish on a banished target will cancel the spell.  Only works on Demons and Elementals.

abilities.name: Create Firestone
abilities.tooltipTemplate: While applied to target weapon it increases damage dealt by direct spells by 1% and spell critical strike rating by 28.  Lasts for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Create Healthstone
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Creates a Major Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 1200 health.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Create Soulstone
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Creates a Major Soulstone.  The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul.  If the target dies while his soul is stored, he will be able to resurrect with 2200 health and 2800 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Create Spellstone
abilities.tooltipTemplate: While applied to target weapon it increases damage dealt by periodic spells by 1% and spell haste rating by 30.  Lasts for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Dark Apotheosis
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Transform yourself into a demon, increasing your health by 15%, armor contribution from cloth items by 666% and significantly increasing your threat. While shapeshifted you cannot be interrupted by monsters, become immune to pushback effects, and damage dealt by you and your pets is reduced by 30%.

While in Dark Apotheosis your Searing Pain spell is instant and you learn Provoke, Soul Gorge and Maw of Dread.

abilities.name: Demon Skin
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 265, and increasing the amount of health generated through spells and effects by 20%. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Warlock at any time.  Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Demonic Circle: Summon
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You summon a Demonic Circle at your feet, lasting 6 min. You can only have one Demonic Circle active at a time.

abilities.name: Demonic Empowerment
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Grants the Warlock's summoned demon Empowerment.

Imp - Increases the Imp's spell critical strike chance by 20% for 30 sec.

Voidwalker - Increases the Voidwalker's health by 20%, and its threat generated from spells and attacks by 20% for 20 sec.

Succubus - Instantly vanishes, causing the Succubus to go into an improved Invisibility state. The vanish effect removes all stuns, snares and movement impairing effects from the Succubus.

Felhunter - Dispels all magical effects from the Felhunter.

Felguard - Increases the Felguard's attack speed by 20% and breaks all stun, snare and movement impairing effects and makes your Felguard immune to them for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Detect Invisibility
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows the friendly target to detect lesser invisibility for 10 min.

abilities.name: Eye of Kilrogg
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it.  The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.

abilities.name: Fel Armor
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Surrounds the caster with fel energy, increasing spell power by 50 plus additional spell power equal to 30% of your Spirit. In addition, you regain 2% of your maximum health every 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Warlock at any time.  Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Health Funnel
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Gives 153 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec.  An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 1 min.

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You transform into a Demon for 30 sec.  This form increases your armor contribution from items by 600%, damage by 20%, reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6% and reduces the duration of stun and snare effects by 50%.  You gain some unique demon abilities in addition to your normal abilities.

abilities.name: Reign of Dread
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Surge into the air and scorch all enemies below with 1590 Shadowflame damage over 2.5 seconds. While airborne melee attacks against you have 60% increased chance to miss.

abilities.name: Ritual of Doom
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant's health to summon a doomguard. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual.  In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

abilities.name: Ritual of Summoning
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal.  The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member.  The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete.  In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

abilities.name: Shadow Ward
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Absorbs 875 shadow damage.  Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Soulshatter
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Reduces threat by 50% for all enemies within 50 yards.

abilities.name: Summon Felhunter
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Summon Imp
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Summon Succubus
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Summon Voidwalker
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Summoner's Armor
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases spell power of summoned demons by 1.5 and attack power of summoned demons by 2.1. Only one type of Warlock Armor spell can be active at any time. Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Temporary Enslave Demon
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Enslaves the target demon, up to level 64, forcing it to do your bidding.  While enslaved, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 30% and its casting speed is slowed by 20%.  Lasts up to 5 min.

abilities.name: Unending Breath
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

abilities.name: Chaos Bolt
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Sends a bolt of chaotic fire at the enemy, dealing 870 to 1049 Shadowflame damage. Chaos Bolt cannot be resisted, and pierces through all absorption effects.

abilities.name: Hellfire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 208 Fire damage to himself and 212 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec.  Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Immolate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Burns the enemy for 279 Fire damage and then an additional 510 Fire damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Incinerate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Deals 337 to 396 Fire damage to your target and an additional 84.25 Fire damage if the target is affected by an Immolate spell.

abilities.name: Rain of Fire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 1288 Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Searing Pain
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 208 to 244 Fire damage.  Causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Searing Pain (Perilous Pain)
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 274 to 316 Fire damage.  Causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 511 to 570 Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Shadowburn
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Instantly blasts the target for 118 to 130 Shadowflame damage.  If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

abilities.name: Shadowflame
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 432 to 485 Shadow damage and an additional 644 Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowfury
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Shadowfury is unleashed, causing 357 to 421 Shadow damage and stunning all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Soul Fire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 715 to 893 Fire damage.
